name: Tachibana Kimika
source:
The female doctor who becomes the protagonist’s attending physician. At the hospital where she works, she’s highly regarded as an outstanding physician.

With a voluptuous bust, hips that seem ready to burst out of her clothes, a tightly defined waist, and above all, her intelligence, captivates men who can't help but their heads. She epitomizes beauty.

She has an open and cheerful personality, but… deep down, she’s incredibly sexy and sexually liberated.

She takes a liking to the protagonist and, under the guise of treatment, tries all sorts of sexy things with him. Is her goal really just sex, or is there more to it...?

Her passionate and sensual lovemaking will overwhelm you, just as the phrase “being milked dry” suggests.
